# Dr. Farzad Ahmadipour Hedesh (دکتر فرزاد احمدی‌پور هدش)

> Official bilingual (Persian/English) academic and professional website of Dr. Farzad Ahmadipour Hedesh: Ph.D. in Electrical Power Engineering, university lecturer at Islamic Azad University, peer reviewer for the Journal of Energy Storage (Elsevier), and CEO of Karavand Entrepreneurship Institute. Based in Tehran, Iran.

The site is a single-page profile available in two language versions. Both versions contain the same sections: About, Publications, Work Experience, Education, Courses Taught, Certificates & Awards, Commendations, Executive Roles at Islamic Azad University, Media Interviews, and Contact/Links. Persian (fa) is the default version; English (en) is the translation.

## Main pages

- [Persian version (default)](https://farzadahmadipour.github.io/): Full profile in Persian
- [English version](https://farzadahmadipour.github.io/en.html): Full profile in English

## Resume and documents

- [Resume (PDF, June 2026)](https://farzadahmadipour.github.io/Resume-june-2026.pdf): Full resume

- [Cultural CV (PDF)](https://farzadahmadipour.github.io/farhangi.pdf): Cultural and executive activities at Islamic Azad University (Persian)

## Research focus

Multi-energy microgrids, energy storage systems, coordination of integrated electricity and gas networks, optimization with carbon emission considerations, smart grids, and renewable energy integration.

Publications listed on the site:
- A Decentralized Model for Coordinating Multi-Energy Microgrids in Integrated Electricity and Gas Networks with Carbon Emission Considerations (Journal of Energy Storage)
- Market-Based Coordination of Decentralized Multi-Energy Microgrids Using Energy Storage Systems and Electric Vehicle Batteries under Dynamic Carbon Pricing (Journal of Energy Storage)
- Book: Cathodic Protection and Thermoelectric Generator with Ammonia-Based Cooling System ([ResearchGate](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/394433126_Cathodic_Protection_and_Thermoelectric_Generator_with_Ammonia-Based_Cooling_System))
- Karavand Entrepreneurship Journal, Islamic Azad University (editor-in-chief / managing director) ([journal page](https://stumag.iau.ir/publications/1980/))

## Professional roles

- Ph.D. in Electrical Power Engineering, Islamic Azad University, Damavand Branch (from 2019)
- University Lecturer, Islamic Azad University: Pardis Science & Technology Branch and East Tehran Branch (from 2023). Courses include Smart Power Grids, Power Systems Analysis, Insulators & High Voltage, Electrical Machines, Electrical Safety, and Technical Illumination.
- Peer Reviewer, Journal of Energy Storage (Elsevier), from July 2025
- CEO and Chairman of the Board, Karavand Entrepreneurship Institute (from 2021), a licensed educational and skills-training institute
- Previous: Operations, Security & IT Specialist at Behpardakht Mellat Bank data center (2024-2025); electrical engineer in building electrical and smart-building design (2013-2024)
